name: No-root services starter
purpose: on a phone WITHOUT root: starts SpacetimeDB and the App API runtime in the PowOS image (their own units: dev.powos.spacetimedb, app-api) and publishes the APK's apps' modules - the rooted phone's powos-supervisor does this there (docs/research/nonroot-parity.md #2)
installedBy: the APK (assets/powos-noroot-services from lib/apps/powos-noroot-services), copied to the engine's run dir and run through EngineGuest by linux/EngineServices.kt; nothing installed in the image

remove.note: a one-shot starter: it exits once the services are started; removing the launcher's assets removes it
